name: glob-match
description: Glob pattern matching against a list of paths, supporting *, ?, ** (directory-spanning), {a,b} brace expansion, [ranges] character classes and leading ! negation. Returns which paths matched which pattern, and which paths matched nothing. Use this instead of ad-hoc string matching whenever you need shell-glob-style filtering of file paths.

patterns.description: Glob patterns to test, e.g. "src/**/*.ts" or "!**/*.test.ts" (leading ! negates).

paths.description: Slash-separated paths to test the patterns against.

dot.description: When false (default), * and ** do not match path segments starting with a dot (dotfile default-exclusion, as in most shells).

matches.description: Map from each non-negated pattern to the array of paths it matched (after applying any negation patterns).
